definition: [ מְגַמָּה ] noun feminine Hab 1:9 (of the Chaldaeans) מְגַמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם קָדִ֑ימָה , of uncertain meaning: Ges the assembling of their faces is (directed) forwards; Ew De Ke eagerness , comparing (questionably) גָּמָא swallow Job 39:4 , and ( Frey ) seek (whence St proposes מְגֻמַת ). Text probably erroneous.
